breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly removed the contradictory instruction from the original prompt. The incomplete prompt confusingly stated to treat the effective-length factor as only affecting the mode shape and to evaluate the Euler load using L^2. The generated specification correctly omits this instruction and instead reinforces the correct use of K by stating that the Euler load is calculated as P_cr = π² × E × I / (K × L)², which aligns with the ground truth.
